environment: LOCAL pure shared BigInt pricing; no database or provider

cases.name: Percent strings and finite numeric values normalize without a floating money calculation
The supplied A/B/C example is exactly 410000 list, 52000 discount and 358000 payable
Four decimal percentage digits remain exact
Discounted unit VND rounds first, then quantity multiplies that same displayed unit
Two-decimal package quantities calculate from the rounded net unit
One hundred percent discount is valid and creates zero monetary total
Disabled VAT returns actual zero without depending on a tax configuration
Explicit VAT is calculated per net line and shipping is added once
VAT half-VND rounds up and four-decimal VAT is supported
Shipping without VAT and an empty preview have deterministic totals
Money beyond JavaScript safe integers remains exact as strings
Negative, over-limit, nonfinite, scientific and overprecision discount inputs are rejected
Nonpositive, scientific, excessive precision or oversized quantities are rejected
Malformed price and shipping amounts are rejected rather than coerced
Invalid VAT configuration is rejected when VAT is explicitly selected
Numeric30 monetary bounds hold for the unit, line, VAT, invoice and shipping sum
Invoice aggregation rejects inconsistent caller-supplied line totals

rounding: Discounted unit VND HALF_UP first; then quantity and explicit per-line VAT HALF_UP
